label: Proun 99
source: Proun 99, El Lissitzky (1890–1941), between 1923 and 1925 (This photographic reproduction is therefore also considered to be in the public domain in the United States.) https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:El_Lissitzky_-_Proun_99_-_1941.548_-_Yale_University_Art_Gallery.jpg
notes: The faceted black-grey-white form hangs impossibly in flat grey space, steadied by a thin red arc and a hatched fan converging to a point, so it delivers quiet wonder at an engineered impossibility rather than agitation — a calm, hovering strangeness that invites long looking. | Kept by Claude from cutouts/run-1 on Brandon's 'use the database we have so far' (2026-11-05); the uncropped whole image came out clean.
